title: Fractional distillation of alcohol and water
subject: chemistry

steps.instruction: Pour the alcohol-water mixture into the distillation flask.
Set up the fractionating column above the flask.
Heat and collect the first fraction at ~78°C in the receiving flask.

rules.feedback: The alcohol-water mixture is in the distillation flask.
The fractionating column provides multiple condensation-vaporization cycles.
Ethanol (boiling at 78°C) collects first as the first fraction.

outcomes.title: Fractions separated
outcomes.description: Ethanol-rich vapor collected first, followed by water. The column allows separation of liquids with close boiling points.

safeFailure.message: Check the temperature and collection points.
safeFailure.guidance: Ethanol boils at ~78°C, water at 100°C. Switch flasks at the right temperature.

narration.text: Pour the alcohol-water mixture into the distillation flask. The mixture fills the flask about three-quarters full.
Set up the fractionating column above the flask. The column is packed with glass beads to increase surface area.
Heat gently. The temperature will rise to 78°C as ethanol vaporizes first. Collect this first fraction.
